## Checklist

- [ ] `mvn -B verify` passes
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] A keyword file is still streamed, never read into memory in full
- [ ] Docs updated where needed (`README.md`, and `README.ja.md` too if you
      can; `docs/test-spec.md` if the behaviour changed)
- [ ] Nothing specific to your machine (user names, local paths, ...)
